transfer.title: Transfer Safety Wizard
transfer.description: Step-by-step non-signable transfer planner with allocation simulation and risk checks.

steps.title: 1. Specify Rune Inputs
steps.description: Select rune-bearing outpoints and their known atomic balances.

steps.title: 2. Define Recipients & Amounts
steps.description: Enter destination script/address and rune amounts.

steps.title: 3. Configure Output Order
steps.description: Set final output ordering, change output, and OP_RETURN location.

steps.title: 4. Simulate Allocation
steps.description: Verify that all balances are conserved and unallocated runes go where intended.

steps.title: 5. Review Safety Checklist
steps.description: Pre-signing warnings: unallocated balances, dust limits, and co-located asset checks.

mint.title: Mint Readiness Wizard
mint.description: Evaluate terms, absolute and relative windows, remaining cap, and destination output.

steps.title: 1. Target Rune ID
steps.description: Enter block and transaction index of the rune to mint.

steps.title: 2. Inspect Mint Terms
steps.description: Review cap, amount per mint, HeightStart/End, and OffsetStart/End.

steps.title: 3. Current Block Height
steps.description: Compare current chain height against the effective window.

steps.title: 4. Readiness Verdict
steps.description: Deterministic verdict: Open, Closed, Not Started, or Cap Reached.

etch.title: Etching Planner
etch.description: Plan and inspect an etching from base-26 name encoding through 6-confirmation commitment to reveal script.

steps.title: 1. Rune Name & Spacers
steps.description: Validate A-Z characters, spacers bitmap, and modified base-26 integer.

steps.title: 2. Name Unlock Schedule
steps.description: Verify name length against activation block 840,000 and current height.

steps.title: 3. Commitment Transaction Plan
steps.description: Calculate little-endian trimmed commitment bytes and 6-confirmation timeline.

steps.title: 4. Configure Supply & Terms
steps.description: Set premine, cap, amount, divisibility, and symbol with u128 overflow check.

steps.title: 5. Generate Reveal Runestone
steps.description: Produce and verify the complete OP_RETURN OP_13 reveal script.
